title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Carbon-aerogel pore and surface designs should differ for gas capture, oil uptake, and removal of dissolved ions.
explanation: The review emphasizes subnanometer pores for mobile small gas molecules, large pore volume and hydrophobic–oleophilic surfaces for oils, and improved wettability for soluble contaminants.
scope: Carbon aerogels for air and water treatment.
conditions: Target contaminant phase and chemistry determine the relevant design.
caveats: Wettability-changing treatments can also alter conductivity, which matters for electrochemical treatment.
